WITH ref AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-111.920729 33.631545)', 4326)::geometry AS g
),
nearest AS (
  SELECT r.road_name,
         r.geometry::geometry AS geom,
         ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-111.920729 33.631545)', 4326)::geography) AS dist_m
  FROM roads r, ref
  WHERE r.highway = 'pedestrian'
    AND r.road_name IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_Dimension(r.geometry::geometry) = 1
    AND ST_NPoints(r.geometry::geometry) BETWEEN 2 AND 50
    AND r.geometry::geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-126, 24, -66, 50, 4326)
    AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-111.920729 33.631545)', 4326)::geography, 100000)
  ORDER BY r.geometry::geometry <-> ref.g
  LIMIT 1
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(n.geom)).geom AS seg FROM nearest n
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
         ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
         ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT e.seg_len_m,
         z1.v AS z1,
         z2.v AS z2
  FROM endpoints e
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p1) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p1)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z1 ON z1.v IS NOT NULL
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p2) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z2 ON z2.v IS NOT NULL
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT seg_len_m,
         CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT n.road_name,
       n.dist_m,
       DEGREES(ATAN(SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0))) AS slope_deg
FROM nearest n
CROSS JOIN slopes
WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY n.road_name, n.dist_m;

  SELECT 
    r.id,
    r.geometry,
    ST_Distance(p.geometry::geometry, r.geometry::geometry) AS distance_meters
  FROM 
    pois p
    JOIN roads r ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geometry, r.geometry::geometry)
  WHERE 
    p.poi_name = 'The Potted Plant Inc.' AND
    p.addr_city = 'Scottsdale' AND
    p.addr_state = 'AZ' AND
    r.highway = 'pedestrian'
  ORDER BY 
    distance_meters
  LIMIT 1
),
road_slope_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    npr.id,
    npr.geometry,
    npr.distance_meters,
    ST_Avg(ST_Slope(r.rast, 1)) AS avg_slope_degrees
  FROM 
    nearest_pedestrian_road npr
    JOIN public.dem_us r ON ST_Intersects(r.rast::geometry, npr.geometry::geometry)
  GROUP BY 
    npr.id, npr.geometry, npr.distance_meters
)
SELECT 
  'The Potted Plant Inc., Scottsdale, AZ' AS feature_name,
  distance_meters,
  avg_slope_degrees
FROM 
  road_slope_analysis;
